Both limbs of the POL-RD-01 establishment test are satisfied on the trace figure: the excess of 0.85 km is greater than the 0.8 km absolute threshold, and the excess of 26.56% is greater than the 20% proportional threshold. The chat log is empty: zero messages, no first or last message timestamp. There is therefore no rider instruction that could exonerate any part of the excess under POL-RD-04, and no waypoint_hint exists to corroborate one. The rider-requested-detour route is closed on this record.

It is not MATERIAL (0.85 km is far below the 8.0 km gate and 26.56% below the 50% gate), so the materiality trigger for the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not engaged. The money does not follow the finding. The charged total was 9.28, giving a refund of 9.28 - 8.96 = 0.32. That is below the SGD 0.50 de minimis_refund, so POL-RD-02 directs NO_ACTION as de minimis and the charge stands. The rider's observation that the route was genuinely longer is accepted as factually correct, but the arithmetic yields no payable amount. The chat log is empty (0 messages), so neither a rider-requested detour (POL-RD-04) nor an endpoint amendment (POL-RD-05) is available on this record. To both parties — this is a provisional ruling made without human review; either of you may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

That is an excess of 0.85 km, or 26.56% of optimal. Both establishment gates are cleared — more than 0.8 km absolute and more than 20% proportional — so the deviation IS established (status 'established' on the derived block), and because the trace carries 37 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100% coverage and a 0 s maximum gap, it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c) and stands on its own without independent corroboration.

The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 + 0.28 x 7.0) x 1.0 (the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, the only artifact that carries it) + 0.80 platform fee = 8.96. The charged_total was 9.28, so the refund is 9.28 - 8.96 = 0.32. That is below the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor in POL-RD-02, so the result on the rider's claim is NO_ACTION as de minimis: the 9.28 charge stands as billed. No ERP or toll line was charged (0.00) and no airport surcharge appears, so there is no billing-integrity or pass-through correction to add under POL-RD-09(4).

THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. 'Followed the app.' cites no artifact and no clause, and under POL-RD-08 a general assertion does not discharge the driver's burden to invoke POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-11 or POL-RD-12. In any event none is available: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02845) is empty, so there is no rider-requested detour; and pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null, so there is no endpoint relocation; the fare is METERED, not UPFRONT_QUOTE, and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL.

THE MISSING ADVISORY. No traffic advisory exists in the bundle for this corridor: EV-ADVIS-02845-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Under POL-RD-13 the absence of an advisory that no party has cited as an excuse is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction, so it does not engage POL-RD-10(5) and does not escalate; POL-RD-03 simply cannot be run. The claim that cited this artifact without disclosing its impairment was discarded at the mechanical check.
